objective:
Prepare and execute a TEST-ONLY Sepolia release of the existing UNLOCK (symbol UNLK) project. Deploy onchain is ON, chainId=11155111, launch kind univ4_hook, ETH pairing, poolBps=8700. No Ethereum mainnet transactions and no website in this task. This is a separate launch from the existing GitHub source, not job.continue or a new implementation from scratch.

Source: https://github.com/identity-md-launches/launch-1309-unlk
Base commit: eb37eb6d1985670dfd2dc691c34a0c879c885b5a
Import this repository through IMD's supported repository-import flow and bind repoUrl/baseCommit in the actual request. Preserve UNLOCK/UNLK, one billion tokens with 18 decimals, final 10% swarm / 87% pool / 3% payer allocation, individual quotas, milestone rules, unrestricted native claims, ordinary transfers and permanent $5M unlock. No upgrades, pausing, admin rule changes, counter resets or trader exemptions.

The requester now authorizes a Sepolia-only experimental deployment and test transactions with test assets. The earlier code-only scope is superseded for this new launch. Keep unresolved economic/security findings disclosed; a successful test deployment is not production approval. Do not weaken controls or fabricate compatibility merely to deploy. Respect platform release checks and report a specific rejection if they prevent this test release.

Resolve Sepolia configuration using current official IMD network/policy data and authoritative Uniswap/Chainlink deployment records. Verify actual code and interfaces; do not reuse mainnet addresses blindly or ask the requester for IMD's private key. Reproduce the build/dependency checks and tests. Run a recorded-block fork rehearsal with local impersonation of the authorized factory deployer; a fork test requires no real deployer key.

Prepare all companion contracts and their one-time bindings: UnlkSwapRouter, MerkleClaimEvidence and UnlkOracle, predicted token/distributor/hook addresses, hook salt/permissions, manifest arguments and initialization order. Confirm how IMD's authorized release service deploys these companions and performs configureHook before the factory launch. Flat hook arguments alone do not prove companion orchestration support. If the service cannot perform the required sequence, report the exact missing operation and deliver a reproducible Sepolia deployment package; do not substitute an unattached hook, a plain pool or another launch type.

Verify one reward leaf per recipient per round against the actual launch allocation tree, and verify payer equals the final allocation recipient. Native claim must remain independent of credit synchronization. Correct obsolete vault/constructor instructions in deployment documentation. Retain fixed quota and oracle rules; do not lower the $5M target or introduce test-only admin bypasses into the deployed contracts. Unreachable tiers in public testing must be reported; exercise them in local/fork scenarios with clearly labeled test data.

After authorized Sepolia deployment, verify the actual PoolKey contains the enforcing hook. Run and report test buys, within-quota sells, rejected excess sells, eligible native claim plus credit synchronization, transfer-only holder behavior, fee collection and principal protection. Claims must obey native release times; never invent eligible claimants or successful tests. Deliver actual Sepolia contract addresses, explorer links, transaction hashes, PoolKey/PoolId, deployed source commit, ABIs, source-verification status and commands/examples to repeat tests. If deployment fails or remains blocked, state that clearly and deliver the exact error and completed artifacts. No claim that UNLK is live on Ethereum mainnet.

When the hook acts: At pool initialization, authenticate the launch factory and bind the official pool once. Before every swap, authenticate the supported router and actual trader. After every swap, atomically record actual acquisitions/sales and enforce the wallet's remaining selling quota, reverting excess sales. After verified permanent $5M full unlock, bypass quotas while retaining authentication and standard fees. On liquidity operations, enforce the existing principal-protection rules. The hook charges no additional fee; preserve the standard 1.25% pool fee and its official distribution. No admin may change these rules.
blockedReason: node manifest: needs_input: The Sepolia addresses of the three companion contracts that UnlkHook's constructor takes as literal words: UnlkSwapRouter (argument 5, router_), MerkleClaimEvidence (argument 6, rewards_) and UnlkOracle (argument 7, oracle_). The univ4_hook manifest can express a constructor word only as an address, an integer or one of $poolManager, $token, $owner, $factory; it has no $contract: reference and no companion slot, and the manifest check refuses stand-ins (zero, 0x...dEaD, low or protocol addresses) and prose. The previous attempt was rejected for writing a prose placeholder. Nothing is deployed
